svg.title: FIG-05 静态连接调用共享 C 生命周期 外部 privileged task owner 串行推进 FIG-05 Static connections call the shared C lifecycle One external privileged task owner advances serially
svg.desc: 冷对象：无成功运行许可 Cold objects: no permission for normal operation; 检查调用上下文和已有状态 ISR／mask／privilege／started Check call context and existing state ISR / mask / privilege / started; 全部 controller 的纯 C 准入 先于 System／资源取得与控制器写入 Pure C admission of every controller Before System/resource acquisition or controller writes; System start 返回 primary／cleanup／remaining effects System start Return primary / cleanup / remaining effects; 取得共享平台资源 Acquire shared platform resources; 按声明次序 prepare 实例 失败但留效的实例计入 cleanup Prepare instances in declaration order Include a failed instance in cleanup if it retained effects; start primary=SUCCESS 外部才开展业务；不启动 scheduler start primary=SUCCESS External application may operate; no scheduler start; 产品关闭 producers／direct writers 继续 drain，join 用户与 observers Product closes producers / direct writers Continue draining; join users and observers; 逆序释放已取得的实例 仅成功后减少保留前缀 Release acquired instances in reverse order Shrink the retained prefix only after success; 释放共享平台资源 Release shared platform resources; 释放所拥有的 System 效果 保持具体 owner 收条 Release owned System effects Preserve each owner's receipts; stop=SUCCESS：可释放效果已清理 不保证继续主动驱动安全电平 stop=SUCCESS: releasable effects are withdrawn No promise to keep actively driving safe levels; 保留 primary Core 执行逆序 rollback 并收集 cleanup Preserve primary Core rolls back in reverse order and collects cleanup; 保留未清理 leases 与存储 继续必要 service，再重试 stop Retain uncleaned leases and storage Continue required service, then retry stop; 拒绝：不准入新业务 保留原生命周期与效果 Reject new operation Preserve the original lifecycle and effects; 显式 start Explicit start; 上下文／STATE 错误 Context / STATE error; 上下文有效且为冷态 Valid context and cold state; 准入失败，无新硬件效果 Admission failed; no new hardware effects; 全部准入通过 All admission passed; System 成功 System succeeded; 启动失败且留有效果 Startup failed with effects retained; 启动失败且未留新效果 Startup failed with no new effects retained; 资源取得成功 Resources acquired; 共享资源取得失败 Shared-resource acquisition failed; 全部成功 All succeeded; 实例取得失败 Instance acquisition failed; 逆序 rollback Reverse rollback; 产品决定停止 Product decides to stop; 已满足 stop 调用前提 Stop preconditions satisfied; 实例全部释放 All instances released; 共享资源全部释放 All shared resources released; 观测清理成功 Withdrawal observed complete; 首个实例释放失败 First instance release failed; 共享资源释放失败 Shared-resource release failed; System 释放失败 System release failed; 按保留阶段重试；不强制回收 Retry retained stages; no forced reclamation; 新生命周期 New lifecycle
